_comment: Content for the README gallery strips, so the images are reproducible:
The numbers are the real ones from RAG-EVAL-VN, not invented: the same measurements
the sample-review-rag video is built on. A gallery showing fabricated figures teaches
the reader that the figures in these templates are decoration.
